en.tagline: Open-source code assistant you configure yourself
en.description: Continue is an open-source assistant for VS Code and JetBrains. You chat about your code and get completions. You choose the models, including local ones. Teams share their settings.
bestFor: Teams that want their own or local models
Developers who want to configure everything
limitations: Setting it up takes some time
